messages:
ada: FYI — scheduled rehearsal for cross-region failover (us-east -> eu-west) Monday 2026-03-30 01:00-01:40 UTC. This is a dry-run to exercise routing, kv-prefix warmup, and client-side retry behavior.

ravi: Requesting temporary SLO window for API read p99 -> 900ms for 01:00-01:20 to reduce noisy pages.

jess: Can we limit it to traffic-weighted canary groups? Suggest 5% traffic to canaries, then 20%, then 100% if green.

maria: We'll pause non-critical changefeeds and batch export jobs 00:30-02:00 UTC. Also setting rate-limits on reindex workers.

opsbot: maintenance record created: m-20260330-xfailover, owner ada, window 2026-03-30T01:00Z-2026-03-30T01:40Z

benchbot: synthetic plan uploaded — 4m ramp to 8k rps, steady 6m at target, verify p99 latency and 5xx < 0.5% for canaries.

ravi: Abort criteria: sustained canary 5xx > 0.8% for 3m OR p99 > 1.2s for 3m. Rollback action: revert route weights + rehydrate old KV nodes.

jess: Watch commands: ```
kubectl -n controlplane get endpoints router -o wide
curl -sS https://internal-health/redwood/health | jq .routes
redis-cli -p 6379 --rdb snapshot-check
```

ada: Security check done, cross-region KMS policy is audited (maria, thanks). Audit logs will stream to S3 for 90d.

maria: I'll own post-run verification: sample 1000 read responses and diff embeddings for drift; quick data-integrity check script: `tools/verify-embeds --sample 1000 --threshold 1e-6`.

ravi: Who's on rollback? tentatively @jess + @ada. Opsbot, notify on-call slack 10m before start.

opsbot: reminder scheduled: 2026-03-30T00:50Z, recipients ada,ravi,jess,maria

ada: Thanks all. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've read and can attend. We'll create the war-room at meeting link: https://meet.redwood/w/xfailover.
